backup.restore_point: PENDING: take a fresh backup as the LAST act before the apply and fill this with its folder (fill-restore-point.mjs)
backup.production_rule: SINGLE SHOT: the migration is not re-runnable. A second run stops on its own md5 guard by design (the three bodies are no longer the ones it was cut from); to undo, apply the rollback. Apply AFTER s81_notices_20261014, s81_staff_pay_push_20261014 and s82_staff_31_20261015: the first block stops (55000, nothing changed) unless staff_push_subscribe_v1(text,text,text,text) is exactly fbda406e0b4e4d80854ce1c383615080, ops_notice_add_v1 is ee6211cfc99aa9735ea2f0f588f38e79 and s_weekly_sweep_v1 is a6082c2fca6d6f2cd136ce9057a1fc99 (md5 of prosrc, CR stripped). Additive except three function bodies: (1) staff_push_subscriptions.topics text[] not null default '{paid}' with a CHECK (1 or 2 entries, only paid and inbox): every existing phone keeps today's paid notice only; (2) staff_push_subscribe_v1 gains an optional p_topics text[]: the 4-argument function is DROPPED and replaced by the 5-argument one (one overload, so a 4-key RPC call from the live Staff app still resolves); with p_topics null it behaves exactly as before and answers {ok:true}; with topics it merges them into the phone's row (asking for one never removes the other), keeps inbox only for an active owner/admin, and answers {ok:true, topics:[...]}; (3) staff_push_unsubscribe_topic_v1(endpoint, topic) removes one topic from the caller's own phone and deletes the row with the last one; (4) staff_push_inbox_recipients_v1() (service role only): the phones that hold inbox, for people who are an active owner/admin right now; (5) table staff_push_claims (RLS on, no API-role grant) and staff_push_claim_v1(key) (service role only): true once per key; s_weekly_sweep_v1 now also deletes claims older than 7 days (everything else in it is byte-identical); (6) ops_notice_add_v1 accepts type brownout (source stays manual; the CHECK lists already allow both; notices_v1 already returns brownout rows as type power). No existing row is changed, no secret is added.
backup.notes: Deploy order, exactly: (1) this SQL (after a fresh backup); (2) the Edge Function notify-staff-inbox with verify_jwt OFF (supabase functions deploy notify-staff-inbox --no-verify-jwt; it also needs the existing secrets VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY, VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY, VAPID_SUBJECT and CASCADE_CRON_SHARED_SECRET - no new secret); (3) messenger-concierge (it starts calling notify-staff-inbox; before step 2 the call 404s and is ignored). Until the Staff app ships a way to turn the Inbox push on, no phone holds the inbox topic and the function answers no_recipients. Rollback of the SQL needs notify-staff-inbox and messenger-concierge left as they are: with the RPCs gone the sender answers rpc_failed and sends nothing.

rollback.safe_until: always. The rollback restores the three function bodies to the exact bodies this release was cut from (md5-checked) and drops what it added. Lost: the topics column (a phone that held only the inbox topic is deleted, so it does not start hearing about payments) and at most 7 days of staff_push_claims keys. Brownouts typed by hand stay and keep showing in notices_v1; a new one can no longer be added (type_not_allowed), as before the release.

compatibility.evidence: Not yet rehearsed: the host rehearsal on a fresh backup is the orchestrator's (s84). Written against the bodies read from the repo history (s81_staff_pay_push, s81_notices, s82_staff_31), md5-checked in the migration's own guard. Neighbour objects: s_weekly_sweep_v1 (redefined with one extra delete and one extra key, rest byte-identical), notify-cleaner-payment (reads staff_push_subscriptions by user_id: unchanged, still sends the paid notice to every phone because default topics is {paid}), staff_push_subscribe_v1 callers (the Staff app sends four keys: still resolves to the five-argument function through the default). notify-cleaner-payment does not filter on topic, so a phone that holds only inbox would also get a paid notice if its owner were a payee; harmless, and the Staff app asks for both topics. Live read pending after the apply: staff_push_inbox_recipients_v1 as service role (0 rows until a phone turns the topic on). Create nothing in production to test it.
